title: Sealed input: the Track 4 contract plus optional entity fields
description: Structure only. The parser in sealed/contract.py applies further rules: blank or repeated ids, repeated keys, non-finite numbers, more than 5,000,000 bytes or objects and arrays nested more than 100 levels deep are rejected; unknown values are degraded, not rejected.

id.description: Required and unique. Identical repeats are replays; differing repeats are all rejected. Shown escaped; never given to a model.

severity.description: One of info, low, review, medium, high, critical (case-insensitive). Anything else, including a missing value or another type, is read as unknown and raises uncertainty. Never given to a model.

signals.description: Each item should match the signal grammar: [count] phrase, for example "five failed synthetic attempts". Items that do not match, of any type, are counted as unrecognised; only the count reaches the model. Missing, null or empty means missing signals.

action.description: The alert's own suggested action, for example "mock step-up". Compared with the policy's decision; it never decides. Unrecognised or missing raises uncertainty.

username.description: Attacker-controllable free text. Quarantined, scanned for instructions, never given to a model.

additionalProperties.description: Other fields are ignored for the decision, counted, quarantined and never given to a model.
Other top-level fields are counted and ignored.
